alternatives.argument: Local composite proof. (1) A free U on omega has a definition from f, ordinals and finitely many S-parameters. At a fresh Cohen coordinate, decide whether the generic real lies in U. A tail-complement automorphism fixing the condition, f, U and those parameters changes the real to its complement modulo a finite set; freeness is invariant under finite modification, contradicting the ultrafilter decision. (2) If kappa is the least ordinal with a free ultrafilter, the least small-piece partition has length kappa, so U is uniform and kappa-complete. Homogeneity of the unused Cohen coordinates makes U restricted to the finite-coordinate ZFC model containing its real parameters an ultrafilter there; N-completeness makes that trace kappa-complete. Hamkins's complete small-forcing theorem reflects the resulting measurable cardinal to L, contradicting Scott's V=L argument. (3) Let W be generated from singletons by well-ordered unions. Prove W closed under subsets, finite products, and surjective images; each finite-modification class and the parameter reservoir lie in W; then use the set of bounded definition codes to obtain a surjection onto every x in N without choosing one code per element, yielding N=W. (4) Induct on W-rank. For X expressed as a well-ordered union, send each point to its least piece. The pushforward of an ultrafilter to the indexing ordinal is principal, so the ultrafilter concentrates on one lower-rank piece; the induction hypothesis makes it principal.
